conventions.internal: Entries with "internal": true are scaffolds, templates, or sub-space internals — registered for count integrity but not listable products.
conventions.marketplace: Optional per-entry Harbor Bay pricing block. Absent = free. See the repository README, section 'Harbor Bay pricing'.
conventions.sub_spaces: Paths of real nested spaces, relative to the parent space folder. Logical relationships between independent spaces are not listed here.
conventions.path: Folder under spaces/ when it differs from id (only social-media, whose paid grant item:social-media predates the folder name).
